caption: The video showcases a shallow, round glass dish resting on a light wooden tabletop, viewed from a fixed, slightly elevated angle. Inside the dish lies a roughly circular white mass whose glossy surface is textured with fine radial streaks and ridges that fan outward from a single central convergence point toward the perimeter. A thin, clear rim of liquid or bare glass surrounds this white disc, separating it from the dish wall. At the left edge of the view sits a glass beaker bearing partial volume markings, while the curved edge of a second clear dish intrudes at the upper-right corner. Bright highlights glint across the ridged white surface, emphasizing the fine radial texture of the mass. Over time the white mass creeps slowly outward, its ridged front advancing toward the dish wall and narrowing the clear gap along the right and lower edges, while the central convergence point stays put. The background objects and the dish stay in place, consistent with a stationary camera. The structure is already largely formed at the start and continues to expand gently to the end.
